{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the premise: internal test orders have revenue == '999999.99'
internal_test_count = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0]
print(f"Number of rows with revenue == '999999.99': {internal_test_count}")

# Check if any rows have revenue containing commas (thousands separators)
print("\nSample of revenue values with commas:")
print(sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).head(10))

# Convert revenue from string to float after removing commas
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Now filter: completed orders AND not internal test orders
completed_no_test = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_no_test['revenue_clean'].sum()

print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders): {total_revenue:,.2f}")

# Sanity check: how many completed orders are left?
print(f"Number of completed orders after excluding test orders: {completed_no_test.shape[0]}")"}
